podcast.body: A 7-inch single released on the obscure indie label Italy Records, backed with "Sugar Never Tasted So Good." This single is extremely valuable for three reasons: its cover was hand-painted by Dave Buick, the label's founder; the vinyl itself was a distinctive red and white swirl, unlike other black, red, or white versions; and only 15 copies were pressed, intended to be sold exclusively at a record release party in Detroit on October 23rd, 1998, for about $6 each. Today, one of these unique copies can sell for over $12,000. "Three things make this single extremely valuable."
